author: Gmelin, 1788
summary: 지금까지 국내 기록이 10건이 안 되는 길잃은새로, 2005년 군산에서 죽은 개체가 발견된 뒤 2006년 외연도, 2010년 제주도, 2014년 6월 백령도에서 기록되었다. 인도에서 동남아시아, 중국 남부와 타이완에 걸쳐 사는 텃새로, 키 큰 풀밭과 덤불, 습지 가장자리에 숨어 지내며 주로 땅에서 먹이를 찾는다. 많은 뻐꾸기와 달리 탁란하지 않고, 덤불이나 낮은 나무에 풀잎으로 지붕 덮인 둥지를 지어 암수가 함께 새끼를 기른다.

art.subject: Lesser Coucal (Centropus bengalensis), adult in breeding plumage: head, neck, underparts and tail black with a dull gloss; wings chestnut, the flight feathers tipped dusky; pale buff shaft streaks often visible on the scapulars and wing coverts; tail long and broad, black. Bill black, short and not deep at the base, with a rounded, arched culmen; eye dark; legs dark grey, with a long straight hind claw.
art.pose: clambering in tall grass with the tail half-cocked, side view
art.scene: Tall grass and reed edge on a southern Korean island in late spring, warm light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view clambering through tall grass with the tail half-cocked: blackish head and body, dark eye, short black bill with a rounded culmen, chestnut wings with greyish-tipped flight feathers and pale shaft streaks on the scapulars and coverts, long black tail, blackish legs
adult breeding, side view perched on top of a grass clump: slim blackish body, short rounded chestnut wings, long black tail held half-cocked, dark eye, short black bill with a rounded culmen
art.build: Medium-sized, slim-bodied ground cuckoo, clearly smaller than Greater Coucal and about the length of a Feral Pigeon including the long tail; short rounded wings and a long, broad, graduated tail often held half-cocked. Bill short, much shorter than the head and less deep at the base than Greater Coucal's, with a rounded, arched culmen. Legs long and strong for a cuckoo, with two toes forward and two back. Skulks and clambers in tall grass; flight short, heavy and floppy.
avoid: Do not paint a bright red iris (Greater Coucal, Centropus sinensis).
Do not paint a short tail; it is long, broad and graduated.
Do not paint a long, deep-based, heavy bill (Greater Coucal) or a slim straight one; the bill is short and black, with a rounded, arched culmen.
Do not paint chestnut on the head or underparts.
